quantity.description: Individual units of this content in the box (pieces, cars, or parts — never packs)

verified.description: false = contents not confirmed against an official source yet; unresolved stays unresolved

pieceTitle.description: LEGACY denormalization for pieceType rows (rows predating 2026-07 car-layer widening always have it). New rows use contentTitle

pieceTypeSlug.description: LEGACY denormalization for pieceType rows — importer/designer consumers filter on this; piece rows keep filling it. New rows also set contentKind/contentSlug

contentKind.description: Which catalog thing family the Pair's second member is. Absent = pieceType (all pre-widening rows)

contentSlug.description: Denormalized content path within its family, e.g. d132/ferrari-296-gt3

contentTitle.description: Denormalized content title for context-free readability
